items.source: Transparently replaces given null user values with an internal NullValue.INSTANCE, if configured to support null values (as indicated by isAllowNullValues()).

items.source: Note: This variant of get does not allow for differentiating between a cached null value and no cache entry found at all. Use the standard Cache.get(Object) variant for that purpose instead.
